title: Pilsen and Pilsner Urquell Brewery Day Trip from Prague
short_description: Visit the brewery where the world’s first golden lager was brewed, and the old town of Pilsen, with your own Mercedes and chauffeur. Door to door from your Prague address, and nobody in your party has to drive after the tasting.
description:
In 1842 a brewer in Pilsen made the first pale, golden lager. Today most beer in the world is a descendant of that recipe, and the Pilsner Urquell brewery where it began is open to visitors. Pilsen is about an hour and a quarter west of Prague by motorway, which makes it an easy and relaxed day out.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague at the time you choose and drives you to the brewery gate. The brewery tour lasts about 110 minutes. It takes you through the brew house, the bottling hall and down into the old sandstone cellars, where you taste unfiltered, unpasteurised beer drawn straight from an oak barrel. Book a tour time before you travel and we plan the pickup around it.

After the brewery the chauffeur drives you into the centre. Republic Square is one of the largest town squares in the country, and the tower of St Bartholomew’s Cathedral in its middle is the tallest church tower in Czechia. The Great Synagogue, the second largest in Europe, is a short walk away, and the old town has plenty of good places for a long lunch.

The car and the chauffeur wait for you for the time included in your booking, which is shown next to the price. If you want more time, add extra hours when you book.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and parking. You see the total before you pay, and the same car and chauffeur bring you back to the door where the day began. Nobody has to drive, so everyone can enjoy the tasting.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. The brewery ticket, other entrance tickets and meals are not included.
highlights: The Pilsner Urquell brewery, home of the first golden lager, brewed here in 1842
The historic cellars and unfiltered beer straight from an oak barrel
The tower of St Bartholomew’s Cathedral, the tallest church tower in Czechia
Republic Square, one of the largest town squares in the country
The Great Synagogue, the second largest in Europe
No designated driver: your chauffeur drives, so everyone can taste

itinerary.title: Pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose, timed so you reach the brewery before your tour starts.

itinerary.title: Drive west to Pilsen
itinerary.body: About an hour and a quarter on the motorway through the Bohemian countryside, with no stops unless you ask for one.

itinerary.title: The brewery tour
itinerary.body: You are dropped at the brewery gate. The tour of about 110 minutes covers the brew house, the bottling hall and the old cellars, and ends with a glass of unfiltered beer from the barrel.

itinerary.title: Lunch at the brewery or in town
itinerary.body: Eat at the brewery restaurant next to the visitor centre, or let the chauffeur take you into the old town for lunch.

itinerary.title: The old town of Pilsen
itinerary.body: Walk around Republic Square, look inside St Bartholomew’s Cathedral or climb its tower, and see the Great Synagogue. Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur drive you back to the same address in Prague where the day began. Rest or sleep in the back.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
The drive to Pilsen and back, including the transfer from the brewery to the old town
Waiting time at the destination for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: The brewery tour ticket: book it yourself for a fixed time before you travel
Other entrance tickets, for example the cathedral tower or the synagogue
A guide: the brewery tour has its own guide, and your chauffeur drives and waits
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address and your brewery tour time when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time.
important_info:
Book your brewery tour on the official Pilsner Urquell visitor website before you travel. Tours in English run at set times and fill up early, especially at weekends. Add the tour time to your booking note and we plan the pickup around it.

The beer tasting at the end of the tour is for adults only. Younger visitors are welcome on the tour.

The brewery is a working site, and parts of the tour may change while building work goes on. The tour includes stairs down to the cellars, and the cellars are cool all year, so bring a light jacket.

Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Tickets and meals are not included.

faq.q: Is the brewery tour ticket included?
faq.a: No. Book the tour yourself on the official brewery website for a fixed time, and tell us the time when you book. The price covers the car and the chauffeur, and we plan the day around your tour.

faq.q: How long is the brewery tour?
faq.a: About 110 minutes, including the tasting in the cellars. Most people spend the rest of the time on lunch and a walk around the old town.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls, parking and the hours in Pilsen included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.

faq.q: Can we bring beer back to Prague?
faq.a: Yes. Buy what you like at the brewery shop; there is room in the boot, and the chauffeur drives you straight back to your door.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.
